prior_threads.reason: The map's origin is answered (won from Bral, beat_72), two locations are read, and Grimny says the hoard is probably in the Dragon's Lair (beat_74). The treasure is still unrecovered and one location is unidentified.
Not touched this Session; Sir Phidipaldi's Clurichen story to Warwick does not bear on Naggeneen.
The party gained allies, armor, a faun-wine plan and the lair's location, but found no poison remedy. The dragon still threatens and the bounty is unclaimed.
Lady Hilda and the wizard Malzazarik joined the party, recruited against Cedric's promissory note rather than a Reeve advance (beat_61). Their pay under that arrangement remains open.
Ned's wasp incapacitated Sir Alfred. Ned remains with the party and his offers still stand.
Cedric and Warwick say supplies stopped when the dragon troubles began (beat_25, beat_28), which partly answers why shipments stopped.
Warwick lent the mithril shirt, holding the plate armor and lyre as collateral, in exchange for metal from the Dwarven mine (beat_34, beat_35). That metal is still owed.

Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows of her visits and is not interested (beat_57), and the shirt was obtained another way. Dunk's promise to Ingrid was never released, so the thread stays open.
Not touched; fairy magic in the forest was only colour.
The swordsman is identified as the undead knight Sir Alfred, and he was incapacitated but not destroyed (beat_9). The danger remains.
The deal was renegotiated: the goblins stay, wall off the stairs and keep the upper rooms (beat_13), and Wayman renewed the promise not to tell King Hogboon (beat_15). That promise remains owed.
The robes proved non-magical (beat_40), and Dr. Uriah promised to return them to the church after the dragon is defeated (beat_24). The chalice question is still open.

new_threads.name: Cedric's promissory note
new_threads.reason: Cedric signed a note for the barrow treasure, tallied at 975 gold, payable once the caravans flow. It is unpaid and has been pledged to recruit allies.

new_threads.name: Vivian's message to Grimny
new_threads.reason: The party agreed to carry Vivian's letter and scent to Grimny. Dunk delivered both to Grimny's ghost, who ascended (beat_78), so nothing remains owed.

new_threads.name: Dunk's dwarven ring
new_threads.reason: Dunk wears a magical ring taken from a dead dwarf that let him see Grimny's ghost. Whether it is cursed is unknown.

new_threads.name: Bral and Grimny's murder
new_threads.reason: Grimny believes his brother Bral killed him, and Bral's whereabouts and the fate of the other dwarves are unknown. Dunk suspects Bral may be faking the dragon.

standalone_beats.reason: Ingrid's wares are a lasting source of remedies, but they belong to no thread.
The party stocked up on Mandrake root tea and Essence of Wolfsbane.
